listening: Listening… The transcript will appear here when someone speaks.
pausedRecording: It will continue when you stop recording, so the new recording runs smoothly.
pausedCall: A call is going on. It will continue when it ends, so your Mac isn't slowed down.

speakers.title: Checking speakers…
speakers.hint: The whole meeting is analyzed again to tell the voices apart better. You can keep reading and editing.

text.title: Improving the transcript…
text.hint: Whisper listens to the meeting again and rewrites the text with punctuation and capitalization. Sentences you corrected are left untouched.

punctuation.title: Adding punctuation…
punctuation.hint: Periods, commas and capital letters. Sentences you corrected are left untouched.

cover.title: Preparing the cover…
cover.hint: The local language model is reading the transcript. You can keep reading and editing.
